body.description: Juno, a teenage girl of about sixteen, the hero: long dark-brown hair in two low tails, rust-red work jacket with a white scarf at the neck, dark patched trousers, worn boots, a canvas satchel with a small battered notebook, a length of steel pipe at her belt, steady watchful face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
